items.question: Will there be parking available?
items.answer: Yes! Parking is available on site at the venue. There is handicap parking, much of the normal parking will be a bit of a walk, however there will be a golf cart picking people up to take them from their cars to the venue so please know that's an option!

items.question: Can I bring my kids?
items.answer: Yes, we ourselves have kids that will be attending, so we do plan to welcome any kids of family and friends that they would like to bring along. Don't want to bring them or prefer to get a sitter? No worries! If you do wish to bring them along just make sure to include them in your RSVP along with ages for our final guest count please.

items.question: Will there be vegetarian food options?
items.answer: Yes! Dinner will be buffet style with several options for main courses and many different options for various sides and salads as well. Eat whatever sounds good to you or meets any dietary restrictions you may have. If there's something particular you think we should be aware of or that requires special prep you can mention it in the RSVP or reach out to one of us directly and we'll do our best to accommodate.

items.question: Can I RSVP before receiving my invitation?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! We still are planning to send out invites, but if you know you'll be coming please RSVP. We would also love for you to share your current address, email, and phone with us at [zola.com/addr/9YyZZ8V6Y](https://www.zola.com/addr/9YyZZ8V6Y)
